name: PMO Programme Status
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Programme:Link/PMO Program:220",
    program_name AS "Programme Name:Data:220",
    program_code AS "Programme Code:Data:140",
    program_manager AS "Programme Manager:Link/User:180",
    strategic_objective AS "Strategic Objective:Link/PMO Strategic Objective:220",
    start_date AS "Start Date:Date:110",
    end_date AS "End Date:Date:110",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Program`
ORDER BY
    CASE status
        WHEN 'In Progress' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Open' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Pending Approval' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Approved' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Draft' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Completed' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Closed' THEN 7
        ELSE 8
    END,
    end_date
